name: Ritesh Sharma
tagline: Weaving dreams with lines of code…
summary: I build web products end to end, from the interface people touch to the systems underneath. Most recently: production frontend at Omniful, an MVP at ZenStreet.ai, and AISEO, an AI-visibility SaaS I architected and shipped.

I learn by building. React internals, Svelte 5, WebGL, LLM pipelines, payments: if it looks hard, I build something with it until it doesn't. I care about how software feels as much as how it holds up.
pullQuote: I code for the joy of building, and for the rush of cracking problems that refuse to be cracked.

bullets: Architected and shipped AISEO, an AI-visibility SaaS: a 22-point audit engine with a 5-stage human-in-the-loop approval flow over Discord.
Cut time to first byte by 87% (2.25 s to 280 ms) with edge-cached static generation and leaner Next.js middleware.
Built Razorpay billing with server-side HMAC-SHA256 verification and atomic credit fulfilment, plus an AI support agent with Groq-to-Gemini failover answering in under 400 ms.
Delivered MVPs for international clients, from scope to production.
Built a custom React toast manager with explicit instance dismissal, plus hooks for stacking, API responses and translations.
Led the migration from Redux to TanStack Query for server state, and introduced Husky and i18n.
Built a 3D driver timeline for the TMS on the Google Maps SDK, with live tracking and shortest-path polylines.
Shipped 20+ client features and fixed critical Sentry issues across the codebase.
Built scalable frontend features for the core MVP.
Closed 30+ high-priority Linear tickets and reviewed code across teams.
Integrated 10+ REST APIs and rebuilt the SaaS landing page, lifting engagement by 60%.
Designed and built the startup's websites with HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript and GSAP.
Pitched three interactive site concepts focused on user experience and calls to action.
Helped the core team run 5+ events.

projects.title: AISEO
projects.summary: Audits how visible a brand is to AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.

caseStudy.problem: Brands had no clear way to see how AI search engines describe them, or what to fix.
caseStudy.approach: A 22-point audit generated by an LLM pipeline, reviewed by a human over Discord before it's published. Credits are reserved atomically in Postgres and refunded on rejection; payments are verified server-side.
caseStudy.outcome: A production SaaS with a 280 ms TTFB, three pricing tiers and an AI support agent that survives provider rate limits.

projects.title: React Mastery
projects.summary: An interview-grade platform that teaches React 19 internals through 20+ interactive sandboxes.

caseStudy.problem: Most React courses explain what to type, not what React and the browser actually do.
caseStudy.approach: Visual modules on Fiber, the DOM and concurrent rendering, a custom hooks toolkit, and a Socket.IO "NPC companion" that nudges learners in real time. Cognito handles stateless JWT auth.
caseStudy.outcome: Load-tested with Artillery against a 3,250-user spike: 100% success and sub-millisecond p95 latency.
